summary: Final retest of the items left open in iteration_35. Tested on mobile web at 375x667. BACKEND FIXED: POST /api/social/posts/{id}/comments returns 200 on posts whose comments field is an array (6 posts tested). The array is left untouched. In the UI the comment posts with 200 and no alert, and the count goes 10->11. Test comments were deleted. FRONTEND FIXED: In en/de the competition-form type names and 'Type * / Name * / Mobile Number * / Password *' are translated. The team/pos/branches EmptyState props are wrapped and the dict entries exist; the empty state itself was not shown because the merchant has data. The services-catalog modules (37 /api/translate calls, all 200), loyalty-programs and the LoyaltyRedeemPicker subtitle (TX) translate on demand. Live-preview Contests shows 'General / Allgemein' and '2456 Participants / Teilnehmer'. The product-form condition pills show '🆕 New / ♻️ Used / 🔧 Refurbished'. All 7 back arrows plus loyalty-history use the chevron-back glyph f229 in en (forward in ar). Dict entries are correct: 'No Stories', 'Home Pickup', 'Points to Next Level', and the checkout slot text has no arrow. Regression: 80 page loads (customer, merchant, chamber and driver × ar/en/de/zh/he) gave 0 pageerrors and 0 red screens. A few small strings are still wrong or untranslated (listed below).

minor.issue: Out of scope, noted only: server.py:1228 still runs an unguarded $inc comments:-1, so it will 500 on posts whose comments field is an array. Add the same {$not:{$type:'array'}} filter that add_comment uses.

issues: merchant/competition-form.tsx:258 preview badge shows raw TYPES name {TYPES.find(...)?.name}. Wrap it with tSync.
merchant/live-preview.tsx:1252 participant-source bar labels show raw label[row.source] ('رابط دعوة', 'تصفح عادي', 'إشعار', 'مشاركة اجتماعية'). Wrap with tSync; the dict keys exist.

merchant/live-preview.tsx:1358 the post sheet 'sharers' tab uses key 'مشاركات', which gives en 'Participations' / de 'Beiträge'. It should be 'Shares' / 'Geteilt'. Use a dedicated key.
merchant/product-form.tsx:336,347 category/brand chips show name_ar in en/de even though name_en exists (for example 'هواتف', 'أبل').
Dict zh: 'سحب عام' = '普通提现' (cash withdrawal) should be '普通抽奖'; 'عامة' = '全部' (all) should be '通用'; 'إضافة فرع' = '添加分支' should be '添加分店'.
translations_cache en: 'SMSA / Aramex / Speel...' ('سبل' should be 'SPL') in the services-catalog description.
